subject: science
passage: Each spring, horseshoe crabs crawl out of the sea onto the beaches of Delaware Bay, on the east coast of the United States, to lay their eggs. Since 1990, teams of volunteers ______ the crabs on these beaches on certain nights in May and June. Their records are now one of the longest-running counts of a marine animal anywhere.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The phrase "Since 1990" describes an action that began in the past and continues to the present, which is what the present perfect expresses. So "have counted" is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The future "will count" does not fit an action that began in 1990.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The simple present "count" does not fit with "Since 1990," which requires a perfect tense.
explanation.C: Correct. The present perfect "have counted" fits "Since 1990," an action that started in the past and continues.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The simple past "counted" suggests a finished action, but "Since 1990" means the counting is still going on.
